title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00386969949992 from paid helper subdivisions on #7776
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.00386969949992**, a directed improvement of **0.00001073765744** over the joint raw upper endpoint 0.00385896184248 of the largest submitted predecessor, #7776. The fixed research target was 0.00386380485468. Giving the predecessor complex word the same new ordinary BIT service still leaves a directed gain of **0.00001037682404**. Please review this complete conditional construction for frontier eligibility under the retained five assumptions.

The binary side adds 21 independently returned fields and qualifies ordinary BIT 0.00386969950. The complex construction adds 15 independent fields to the 48-call word. The final fixed-boundary changes relocate four local scalar banks and replace two paid transfers of ranks 1 and 3 with one rank-4 return. A further same-chart split on owner 1164 creates an independent productive return without another paid transfer. The proof records each of these changes against its immediate parent. Its raw crossing is [0.00386981257852, 0.00386981257853].

## Task and overlap

The assigned scope refines the P104 side-correction and ordinary BIT work to an exact paid subdivision with productive retirement. Canonical main is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Both constructions start from the PR #7776 scientific tree at `4f7c67ae387cc91580f469aeda4d508b372b9ec1`. The new binary word SHA-256 is `861f5181e4f34db638ab0c573c319fe26ff034d63b21242d67220a4a5d6433ff`. The final complex word is `03ef8f6cc9ebb7394b5c7f8da70d44df965659ae4ff361bbc8d32c7a12121445`. The release preserves earlier #7774 and #7776 edits and includes a complete ordinary and signed reprice. [Research coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19725209)

## Validation

The package rebuilds both candidates, checks the full arbitrary-input rows and adjoints, the 36- and 48-call application, exact chart phases, dirty CLEAR and omitted-restoration controls, ordinary work, width and finite outer conditions. Binary has 107,532 paid and 20,418 productive positions. Complex has 283,488 paid and 52,032 productive positions. Source-locked, standard-library Python 3.12 reproduction is in `research/p104-subdivided-helper-births/README.md`. Seven scoped hosted jobs rerun those checks.

This contribution used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate computational verification. [PR #7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776) · [PR #7774](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7774)

## Open next questions

Please audit one subdivision's independent new owner, retained output, and the inverse effect of omitting the paid return. The complete claim retains the native all-column, owned-erasure, compiler, precision-tape and analytic-recovery assumptions. Maintainer admission and independent human or proof-kernel review are open.
